title: GAT 圖注意力網路
summary: 以鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習解析GAT 圖注意力網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore GAT graph attention network through neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在GAT 圖注意力網路案例中比較節點與邊張量與鄰域masked attention，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate node and edge tensors and neighborhood masked attention within the GAT graph attention network case.

steps.title: 圖鄰域遮罩：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對節點與邊張量提出可反駁的圖鄰域遮罩模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable graph-neighborhood masks model and evidence record for node and edge tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識節點與邊張量。GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。 建立圖鄰域遮罩的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify node and edge tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of graph-neighborhood masks, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。
steps.observationEn: List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個GAT節點都必然能看見所有節點。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every GAT node necessarily sees every other node.
steps.check: 提交節點與邊張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for node and edge tensors.

knowledge.title: 圖鄰域遮罩
knowledge.text: GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。 本課架構對應：節點與邊張量
knowledge.textEn: GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph. Course architecture correspondence: Node and edge tensors

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；每個GAT節點都必然能看見所有節點。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every GAT node necessarily sees every other node.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(112×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=344064 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=41984 byte，算術強度=8.1951 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(112x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 344064 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 41984 bytes, intensity 8.1951 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就節點與邊張量的「圖鄰域遮罩」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for graph-neighborhood masks in node and edge tensors?
options: GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。
每個GAT節點都必然能看見所有節點。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph.
Every GAT node necessarily sees every other node.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。 用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。
quiz.explanationEn: GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph. List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph.

steps.title: 圖鄰域遮罩：證據驗證
steps.objective: 針對節點與邊張量提出可反駁的圖鄰域遮罩模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable graph-neighborhood masks model and evidence record for node and edge tensors.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「圖鄰域遮罩」模型，檢查節點與邊張量的兩個假想案例。用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous graph-neighborhood masks model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving node and edge tensors. List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。
steps.observationEn: List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個GAT節點都必然能看見所有節點。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every GAT node necessarily sees every other node.
steps.check: 提交節點與邊張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 非對稱邊權與聚合：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Asymmetric weights and aggregation: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對鄰域masked attention提出可反駁的非對稱邊權與聚合模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable asymmetric weights and aggregation model and evidence record for neighborhood masked attention.
steps.instruction: 在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識鄰域masked attention。注意力aij可與aji不同，即使基礎鄰接圖無向；聚合仍需保留目標節點與來源。 建立非對稱邊權與聚合的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想特徵手算兩方向權重並檢查節點更新。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify neighborhood masked attention in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Attention aij may differ from aji even on undirected adjacency; aggregation retains target/source roles. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of asymmetric weights and aggregation, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate assumed bidirectional weights and check node updates. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用假想特徵手算兩方向權重並檢查節點更新。
steps.observationEn: Calculate assumed bidirectional weights and check node updates.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：無向鄰接圖強制所有注意力權重對稱。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Undirected adjacency forces symmetric attention weights.
steps.check: 提交鄰域masked attention的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for neighborhood masked attention.
